meta.name: M5S Dancing Green — Boss + H2 Scholar Core + Rotation
meta.strategy: M5S Boss Mechanics + H2 Scholar Core + 30s DoT / mechanic-aligned Chain
meta.author: FF14 Timeline Voice Coach
meta.description: M5S Boss + H2 Scholar Core timeline with Scholar rotation reminders added. DoT refresh is reminded every 30 seconds after the opener. Chain Stratagem follows the mechanic-aligned delayed raid-burst timings rather than a rigid 120-second schedule. Existing Chain windows at 246.0s, 365.5s and 484.0s are preserved, with missing windows added around 125.5s and 603.5s. DoT reminders are merged into nearby H2 calls where practical or placed as concise standalone cues while preserving the 2000ms collision window.
